user.title: Daikin intelligent Touch Manager
user.description: The iTM allows one web session at a time. Make sure nobody is logged in to its web interface while you set this up.

data_description.host: Address of the iTM, e.g. 192.168.1.20. Use a full https:// address if your iTM offers HTTPS.
data_description.username: Preferably a dedicated iTM account for Home Assistant.
data_description.zone_path: Path of zone names in the iTM icon view to the zone with the indoor units, separated by '/', e.g. 'Building/Indoor units'. Leave empty if the units are at the top level.

reconfigure.title: Daikin intelligent Touch Manager
reconfigure.description: Change the connection to the iTM. Make sure nobody is logged in to its web interface.

data_description.host: Address of the iTM, e.g. 192.168.1.20. Use a full https:// address if your iTM offers HTTPS.
data_description.username: Preferably a dedicated iTM account for Home Assistant.
data_description.zone_path: Path of zone names in the iTM icon view to the zone with the indoor units, separated by '/', e.g. 'Building/Indoor units'. Leave empty if the units are at the top level.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the iTM.
error.login_rejected: Login refused: wrong credentials, or someone else is logged in to the web interface.
error.zone_not_found: Zone not found. Available at that level: {available}
error.no_units: No indoor units found at this level. Zones there: {available}

abort.reconfigure_successful: The iTM settings have been changed.

init.title: Auto mode
init.description: Auto mode uses the outdoor temperature from Open-Meteo.com to tell the season.

data_description.location: Defaults to the location of Home Assistant.

state.too_cold: too cold, changing over to heating
state.too_warm: too warm, changing over to cooling
state.write_failed: the iTM did not accept the change

state.interval: for the minimum time between changes
state.active_time: for heating or cooling to run 30 minutes
state.changeover: for 2 hours since the last changeover
state.trend: the room is already heading back
state.budget: the daily number of changes is used up

login_rejected.message: The iTM refused the login: wrong credentials, or someone else is logged in to the web interface.

unit_stopped.message: {unit} is off. Turn it on before changing the temperature: the iTM ignores the temperature of a unit that is off.

setpoint_out_of_range.message: {unit} accepts {min} to {max} °C in its current mode, not {temperature} °C.

command_failed.message: The iTM did not accept the change: {error}

weather_failed.message: Could not read the outdoor temperature: {error}

login_rejected.title: The iTM keeps refusing the login
login_rejected.description: The iTM at {host} has refused every login for {minutes} minutes. Either someone is still logged in to its web interface (it allows one session at a time), or the username or password has changed. Log out of the web interface, or update the credentials by reconfiguring the Daikin intelligent Touch Manager integration.
